Exact system tuner for the Inputs menu's Live TV row; opens its channel collection. Empty keeps automatic selection. Missing input or unsupported collection falls back to the app's normal launch. [HAAM satellite example](../docs/devices/haam-r4.md)
The TV's own source panel, for sets with no TvInputManager: a service, or an activity (BYINTEK U4). Without a Live TV app, the Inputs pill opens it directly

Coocaa OS (Skyworth, China): list the sources from com.skyworth.tv in the Inputs menu, ahead of the source panel

Tiles that open a screen of the app instead of its start screen; an action that no longer resolves opens the app normally (MagentaTV's guide: com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl=com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl.action.PROGRAM_GUIDE)
A tile's name instead of the app's own (MagentaTV as com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl=TV)
A tile's artwork from a banner_* drawable bundled with the launcher (banner_tv: magenta with the Live TV glyph)

Action sent with an HDMI/AV row's channel URI when nothing handles the standard VIEW (XGIMI: com.xgimi.action.hdmiPlayer). Only a handler-less set gets here; any app that claims the channel MIME type takes the row instead, so check with query-activities ([#805](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/805))
Scheme an HDMI/AV row's passthrough URI is sent with instead of content://, with no MIME type (YaOS: live-tv, which its source player answers)
